answer_1.quote: A number of recent studies  propose using summarisation systems to automatically generate consultation notes from the verbatim transcript of the consultation-a task henceforth referred to as Note Generation.
datasets: 57 pairs of mock consultation transcripts and summary notes
models: large BART architectures pretrained on the CNN/Dailymail dataset
answer_1.outputs: Subjective part of a SOAP note

answer_2.quote: Borrowing from the field of Automatic Summarisation, most studies on Note Generation rely on ROUGE and fact-extraction based metrics to evaluate the generated notes

answer_4.quote: We perform a large-scale human evaluation conducted by 5 clinicians on a set of 285 consultation notes
answer_4.guideline: Listen to the mock consultation audio and take notes; read 5 different notes and post-edit each one; classify errors into 'incorrect statements' and 'omissions'; report qualitative feedback in 'Other issues' box
